value.rationale: The paper motivates a practical design choice between sample reuse and independence. This theorem exhibits a robust third regime in which a mixed pair coupling is strictly better than reuse, independence and maximal anticorrelation even though all components and maps are contractive. The equal-slope rigidity theorem isolates curvature heterogeneity, and the stationary bias at the optimum exposes why variance minimization alone misleads.
